lines.say: Mehrah Mehrah no Mee. The Flame-Flame Fruit. The fire fruit that was eaten by two brothers.
lines.show: Mera Mera no Mi. The Flame-Flame Fruit. The fire fruit that was eaten by two brothers.

lines.say: Years ago, a young pirate got stranded on a tiny island. He found a strange fruit... and ate it.
lines.show: Years ago, a young pirate got stranded on a tiny island. He found a strange fruit... and ate it.

lines.say: His name was Portgahs Dee Ace. And now he could make fire, control fire, and become fire.
lines.show: His name was Portgas D. Ace. And now he could make fire, control fire, and become fire.

lines.say: It's a Lohjeeah fruit. Swords and bullets pass right through a body made of flames.
lines.show: It's a Logia fruit. Swords and bullets pass right through a body made of flames.

lines.say: His signature move was Fire Fist. So the world gave him a name. Fire Fist Ace.
lines.show: His signature move was Fire Fist. So the world gave him a name. Fire Fist Ace.

lines.say: His biggest attack, Die Enkye, Entay, was a fireball so huge it looked like a second sun.
lines.show: His biggest attack, Dai Enkai: Entei, was a fireball so huge it looked like a second sun.

lines.say: But in the war at Marineford, he met something hotter than fire. Admiral Ahkahyeenoo's magma.
lines.show: But in the war at Marineford, he met something hotter than fire. Admiral Akainu's magma.

lines.say: Ace took the hit to protect his little brother Luffy. And the flame went out.
lines.show: Ace took the hit to protect his little brother Luffy. And the flame went out.

lines.say: But devil fruits come back. Two years later, the Flame-Flame Fruit was the grand prize of a fighting tournament in Dress Rosa.
lines.show: But devil fruits come back. Two years later, the Flame-Flame Fruit was the grand prize of a fighting tournament in Dressrosa.

lines.say: And the winner? Ace's other brother, Sahboh. He ate it, threw his first Fire Fist, and became the Flame Emperor.
lines.show: And the winner? Ace's other brother, Sabo. He ate it, threw his first Fire Fist, and became the Flame Emperor.

lines.say: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
lines.show: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
